item.description: cruach feòir (hay stack).
ciall (sense). Cha’n eil sgot agad.
a chuid sin ann an deireadh luinge anns a bi taoim a laighe.
duan neo rann air a ghabhail ’s bleoghainn a’ chruidh (milking croon).
[NOTES: see below.]
gàine [sic] an dubhain (barb of the hook).
poca anns a biodhta a cumail na saighdean (i [?]).
théid thu ann agus (frown) sgoic ort (Harris expression).
of the same class of words, similar [to sgoic?].
decay, a person losing weight thus. Tha sirig air tighinn ann. (Harris)
a drop. An tug thu bainne o’n bhoin: cha tug silc.
sine bà.
gill’òg (giullan).
talamh bristeach ’na thuill.
neach air a dhol gu mi-dhiu – ’s e troc th’ann.
ciall mar: Cha’n eil bleiream agad. (Harris)
not an iota of a difference as: gun siomal a dh’atharrachadh (Harris expression).
ag iasgach le slait.
Thuit e gun deimeadh. “down for the count [?]”.

stuth air a chruinneachadh de sheòrsa measgaichte anns nach eil mor fheum. Bha trealabhaid dhe. I think it’s an invented form of a word, perhaps originating or derived from the English word “trawling”.
spot, comharra air a chraiceann (beauty spot).
dà leth. Rinn mi conablach dhe.
fiodh air urlar eitheir, pios fiodha fo chasan neach ann an direadh neo toiseachd, eithear beag. Air a bithear a seasamh mar leac-fiodha.
bial eithir air a bheil timchioll àrd suidhichte.
uisg’ as an t-sròin. Bha smuig as an t-sròin aice, neo aige.
leabaidh de chamhlach air an làr – aodach leabadh air a chuir air a lar, neo faodaidh camlach [sic] a bhi foidhe gu cadal air.
dìthean (buttercup).
ean (corncrake).

already referred to previously, is I think a tit bird not any particular one – I know for certain it’s a bird, a tit bird – very likely any tit bird or any of the tit bird family, a general term. I remember hearing the term used years back. This is my definition – perhaps someone else has some other or can have a further definition.
fannachadh laige (1 [?]) le bhi do timchioll: bi e tighinn air caoradh? taisean? – explanation? – tuathalan, luairean. [?]
(into a faint). Chuir mi ann am paiseanadh e.
link of a chain. Sometimes pronounced “teinne”. Dul de shlabhraidh.
ean, faoileag theirear anns na Hearadh: Farspach. Black backed gull.
(bones) as: Cha’n eil annad ach na taisean (bare bones).
fear a bhios a grimeadh air falbh rudan, a criomadh piosan arain. From greim. [NOTES: the last piece of information added on one of the following pages, see below.]
[See grimire.]
rudan a thig air a mhuir gu tir – rud ’s a bith. An t’fhuair thu murragan an diugh air a’ chladach?
ni air a thilgeal pios de sglart [?] (slate) gu bhi srucadh air uachdar na mara neo air an uisge.
pios leathair anns a bi clach air a cur s an leathar sin le da thraing as air a shuaibeadh gu bhi tilgeal na cloiche (sling).
cleasachd, dòigh cur seachad am measg na balach sgoile.
(large or extra large). Clonstar mhor cloiche. Bha e lorg clach mhor ’s fhuair e ’n sin clonstar, a thilg e.
Bha e dha clapanaich (clapping her on the shoulder).
ceann shuas tigh tubhaidh, pairt shuas an tighe etc.
(division) part of a house, a dividing wall: bhiodhta cleachdadh an fhacail gu h-àraidh anns na seann tighe – tighe tubhaidh.
lar, seòrsa lair a bhiodhadh ann an tigh – ‘taigh’ tubhaidh.

here (bunan fhiaclan grota) anns a bhanas or crows. Perhaps there is a proper rendering. I am not quite sure if this is exactly? I am doubtful. I know there is such a word for bunan fhiaclan grota anns a bhanas?
seiceil ann an cuibheal shniomh (from shackle).
aghaidh nach ann air tha an aghaidh, sichd (cheek [?]).
druthag uisge air ùrlar shoithich.
an endearing female, kind, well-liked etc., nighean òg chaomh.
dripeil, trang (busy).
ean cailleach oidhche (another name for it).
An tu tha sud a ghalahad (referring to a female).
Tha e cho math dhuit chuir dh’an phannt, pawn (pawn shop).
sgian lighiche (lance).
siola na h-easgainn. Part of the entrails of an eel. From siol.
a laughing stock, cuis mhagaidh.
galair (chicken pox).
theirear anns na Hearadh smalag (nach e?).
a halfwit person (duine caran bharr a bhi ceart).
sparr ann an tigh dubh (parting).
beggar’s roost. Cha urrain dhomh a radha gu firinneachd an e bochduinn mar a theirte “poor house” seo mar a shaoileas mi e?
’Se spiolag (naughty girl) th’innte.
[See spiolag.]
from greim (previously noted) on a former page. I forgot to explain. [NOTES: see ‘grimire’ above.]
from crimeag.
(a child’s palm). Cum do chrùcan.
aftermath, ni de’n h-uile rud air fhagail a deighidh sabaist neo cath ’s a bith.
quite a portion. Fhuair e sòs [sic] math, cuibhrionn mhath.
(complete mess) Tha thu (mi) air do ghrànrachadh [sic] leis.
(missile) spitheag cloiche.
da fhacal cuideachd gu bhi air a chleachdadh gu eagail a chuir air leanabh ma bhios e dol a àite nach saoilear a bhi freagarrach.
nàduir feamainn (dulse).
(button on the top of a mast) anns na soithichean móra, air mullach a chrionn, putan air mullach crann gu bhi cumail an uisg ás.
’S e dh’iap tha sud. Yob from yob – a current expression.
Rug e air bhalg meadhoinn [sic] air (belly bulge). Meadhainn – middle.
bior fiodha (peg).
air son cul an dùirn, bracelet.
ciste-laighe. (Harris)
(small amount) caoirnean dhe a’ cliucheadh (sgadan).
prìne (pin).
companach (from comrade).
iasg (sprat).
beathach (ferret).
dorus. Cul na còmhla.
beauty spot. “More associated with a beautify expression than ball-dobhrain” mark on the skin.
rud beag de dh’aoraich aithneachadh: bha suaigean air (happy).
buile, droch bhuille. Fhuair e seannsal.
sròn mar a mach. Bha soic a mach oirre (protruding nose).
cho marbh anns an tuaim: neo thainig tuaim-thàmh – death sleep, rest.
insect of the beetle family.
from sank. Chaidh e sonc.
iasg (bodach ruadh beag).
linn air a cur le clachan gu a toirt fodha (with stone sinkers).
amhras an linn: thoir thugad an t-amhras chuid dhe air fhidheadh.
gu bhi deanamh iarnachan de shnath.
làn duirn bheag mar boiseag mhine (wee handful).
a deanamh striochd le oisean na spaide ’g bualadh air an talamh mar a bhios neach a bhios a’ cur buntàta ni e striochd air meud a cheap… brig an toiseachd e.
(force) wind blowing to a force as: Tha suitseach oirre.
mixture of material of a distasteful approach: Cha’n eil an sud ach srulais. Srulais gu leoir aige (gossip).
scowl on the face with the mouth to reveal it. Drein a’ cur a bheòil ann an cruth.
(death) an old expression. “Theasd e” confined to the Mainland area: Perthshire and perhaps Argyllshire.
substitutional [sic] term. Fac thu rudan.
planca (plank in English).
[See plang.]
a jerk forward. Thug e gothadh as – referring to a person falling from a pier or wall into the sea – ’s chaidh e, neo thuit e mach air a’ mhuir (1). (2) there is the word “goth” – judging.
Tha drabhs aig air an teine (fuaim mar a bhios ag geir ’n uair a thilgear pios dhi dh’an teine).
Fhuair e sgiuch mhath ann – he got a good portion there. Thug e sgiuch bhuaipe.
Cè gidseog tombaca – a wee cut of tobacco.
pios tombaca air son a chagnadh (chewing).
àit air son preis dhath, ait [sic] air bi preis dhath air a suidheachadh.
